Body.Content:
The localized version for France is now available as a set of extensions on the W1 base app. This version includes a data upgrade feature to simplify the transition from the previous localization. This release moves the product closer to full delocalization, so ISVs can reach a wider market. Some features move to the base app or become global apps, while others stay specific to the French market.

GA date: February CY2027

Preview date: November CY2026
